messages.subject: Prediction of the rainfall example
parts:
Dear all,

I am working on a hurdle model that is similar with the rainfall example, with two likelihoods - bernoulli and gamma. Is there any guidance on how to get precitions of the hurdle model? 

Thanks,
Rujia

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Prediction of the rainfall example
parts:
If you wnt to do it super-correct, you have to use
inla.posterior.sample(), this is easy and general.

A little more approximate approach, is to use the posterior marginals
for prob for rain and the posterior for the linear predictor of the
gamma [using plugin for the hyperpar in that one].

H
